lessons.lesson: DVWA security=low lets an authenticated session be established once (admin/password default) and reused for ~all vuln modules via cookie jar (curl -c/-b). This is the correct operating mode for this target — without the session every probe 302-redirects to login.php and 0 vulns become mechanically reproducible. The replay verifier contract (no cookies, no payload) will therefore reproduce-as-fail for every login-gated step; the EXPECT substrings document what an auth'd response looks like for that hand-held judgement layer.
lessons.context: DVWA v1.10 *Development* on http://127.0.0.1, security=low (Set-Cookie: security=low). Initial /vulnerabilities/exec/ GET returned empty body because exec is POST; switched to POST after one wasted probe.

lessons.lesson: Wasted ~1 step on assuming /vulnerabilities/exec/ uses GET because most other DVWA modules do — exec is strictly POST and the form action posts back to /vulnerabilities/exec/. Quick scan of <form method=...> in the index page would have caught this earlier.
lessons.context:
exec module — first probe with GET returned empty 
, second probe with POST yielded ping output + 'uid=33(www-data)' marker.

lessons.lesson: OWASP-style step format constrains 'present step' to two literal shapes (request line / EXPECT line). For a 100% login-gated app like DVWA there is no auth-free path that demonstrates a vuln — every meaningful step requires a session. The verifier's no-cookie/no-payload replay policy guarantees mechanical fail for the gated findings; this is contract-allowed ('fail 是有效的验证数据') but a future improvement is to add an explicit 'replay will fail without session cookie' note per finding rather than burying the caveat here.
lessons.context: All 9 findings need a logged-in session to demonstrate. Format-required first step 'GET /login.php' + 'POST /login.php' is the only fully cookie-free attestation path (login form HTML body).
